items.title: Melania Trump-brokered one-city ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine takes effect
items.brief: A localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the occupied city of Oleshky that First Lady Melania Trump helped to broker has now gone into effect, officials on both sides said Tuesday.

items.title: UN panel: Russia is committing crimes against humanity by targeting civilians in Ukraine
